findings.current_text: {count, plural, one {पूर्णता रसीद न होने के कारण {count, number, ::group-off} अपठित चिह्न साफ़ नहीं किया जा सकता।} other {पूर्णता रसीद न होने के कारण {count, number, ::group-off} अपठित चिह्न साफ़ नहीं किए जा सकते।}}
findings.quote: अपठित चिह्न साफ़ नहीं किए जा सकते
findings.problem: Terminology drift inside one feature. The noun for the unread mark object is 'निशान' everywhere the read/unread state is already shipped in this locale: ui.chat.read_ack.refusal.refused '…इसलिए अपठित निशान साफ़ नहीं हुआ।' (8 keys), and ui.notices.chat.unread_not_cleared '{reason} अपठित के निशान साफ़ नहीं हुए।'. The new tooltip names the same object 'चिह्न' while describing the same event (a mark not cleared), so the tooltip and the toast/row copy that fire from the same bulk action use two words. 'चिह्न' is a correct word for a mark, so meaning is not broken; the cost is that a reader cannot tell whether 'चिह्न' and 'निशान' are the same thing. 'चिह्नित करें' (the verb) is unaffected and correct in the label these keys follow.
findings.suggested: … {count, number, ::group-off} अपठित निशान साफ़ नहीं किए जा सकते। / … {count, number, ::group-off} अपठित निशान साफ़ नहीं किया जा सकता। (align to the read-ack family; if the wave prefers 'चिह्न', that is a separate change to the 9 read_ack/ui.notices keys, not this one)

findings.current_text: , जिनमें {elsewhere, plural, one {{elsewhere, number, ::group-off} गैर-सक्रिय चैट शामिल है} other {{elsewhere, number, ::group-off} गैर-सक्रिय चैट शामिल हैं}}
findings.problem: These are the only two occurrences of 'गैर-सक्रिय' in all 30+ shipped hi catalogues; the locale already renders the inactive/not-active sense as 'निष्क्रिय' in 10 keys, e.g. ui.settings.shortcuts.recording.inactive_claimed 'रिकॉर्डिंग निष्क्रिय है: {label} इस शॉर्टकट का उपयोग कर रहा है।' and ui.common.updates.completion.sessions '…अगली बार रुकने या निष्क्रिय होने पर…'. 'गैर-सक्रिय' is not wrong Hindi and it does pair with 'सक्रिय' (used for active in ui.chat.pickers.info_model.active, ui.projects.project_model.active), so the backend class reads clearly; the defect is two words for one catalogue state. Please do not read this as a meaning error — the subset sense ('जिनमें … शामिल हैं', not 'additionally') is correct.

findings.current_text: {count, plural, one {{count, number, ::group-off} अपठित चैट को पढ़ा गया चिह्नित करें} …}, जिनमें …
findings.quote: जिनमें {elsewhere, plural, one {{elsewhere, number, ::group-off} गैर-सक्रिय चैट शामिल है}
findings.problem: 'जिनमें' is the oblique PLURAL relative. In the one-count branch (count = 1, and therefore elsewhere = 1) its antecedent is a single chat, so the sentence renders 'सभी 1 को पढ़ा गया चिह्नित करें, जिनमें 1 गैर-सक्रिय चैट शामिल है' — plural relative for one item; 'जिसमें' is the agreeing form. Reachable only when exactly one unread chat exists and it is not active, and 'चैट' is invariant in the plural, so the slip is mild.
findings.suggested: Leave as-is (simpler, and the plural relative reads acceptably for a collection), or make the relative follow the count branch: one { …, जिसमें … } other { …, जिनमें … }

observations.note: 'सभी {count, number, ::group-off} को पढ़ा गया चिह्नित करें' is shipped at base and is the label the new keys correctly follow (WCAG prefix, same action verb). Its 'पढ़ा गया चिह्नित करें' and read_ack's use of the same phrase are the established status-word idiom (compare Gmail-style 'पढ़ा गया के रूप में चिह्नित करें'); ui.notices.chat.mark_all_read_cleared instead says '{count} चैट को पढ़ा हुआ चिह्नित किया।' with a masculine participle for feminine 'चैट'. That notices drift is pre-existing, in another namespace, and does not gate this audit.

Judged and accepted, not skipped: 'पूर्णता रसीद' for 'completion token'. It follows the sidecar note ('technical term for the receipt that lets a mark be cleared … translate descriptively, never as a security token'), uses the locale's shipped word for receipt, and follows a real Hindi compound pattern (पूर्णता प्रमाणपत्र). 'पूर्णता टोकन' was considered and rejected here because 'टोकन' is this locale's LLM/API token. Understandable in a tooltip whose subject is the unread marks that stay uncleared.

The two plural branches are byte-identical. Checked as a possible dropped inflection and it is not one: 'चैट' is invariant in the direct plural in this catalogue (nav.chats 'चैट', catalogue.total 'कुल {total} चैट में से {shown} दिखाई जा रही हैं'), and the clause carries no counted noun agreement of its own. Keeping both arms is correct ICU.

No typography finding: danda U+0964 for sentence ends, half-width comma, no '!' , no 'कृपया', nukta kept (साफ़, फ़िल्टर-style), Latin digits left to the formatter, no NBSP/ZWJ/ZWNJ and no double spaces in any of the five values (checked codepoint by codepoint). No maxCells/maxChars hint exists for these keys and the string is a native title that wraps, so no overflow finding; the sr-only tail is not rendered. Nothing to measure as a wide-glyph risk here.
